Amantadine Madness
T- 4pm: I was searching through my medical cabinet, hoping to find something good and all I found were pills with amantadine, I started teaching for info and all I found was that this could cause delirium at really high doses, so I took the whole box and went to sleep for 2 hours.
T- 6pm: i woke up and went to the bathroom and noticed I felt weird and then I looked in the mirror and saw a death-like figure behind me and I turned back and saw nothing. I went to my room and I saw a tree on the middle of my room, but when I got close to it, it disappear
T- 7pm - 9pm: I SAW EVERYTHING, I felt like I was connected to everything, all in my room was like a forest, I saw creatures from fairytales, I saw flowers, spiders, animals, I saw flying things on my roof, and then the death-like creature came back and opened my door, leading me into a pond where I felt like I knew everything, all seamed clear and then I got back to my room.
T- 10pm - 5am- In the come down I just kept seeing this flying balls on the roof and the forest creatures where still in my room with me.
